Same-day Delivery Service*

No reservations are required.

We offer our Same-day Delivery Service between Aiport/Station and your hotel.
*Same-day Delivery is available to limited destinations from limited sales offices.
Cut-off time and Delivery time varies depending on sales offices.
Delivery may be delayed due to the weather, traffic, and increased volume of parcels.

Sample Itinerary

  • Arrive at Haneda Airport
    Send your baggage from a Yamato counter at the airport to the hotel you are going to stay on your first night.

  • See the Sights
    Since you don’t need to drop off your baggage at the hotel, you can go sightseeing straight away, allowing you to use your time effectively.

  • Check into Your Hotel
    When you arrive to check in at the hotel, you will find that your baggage is waiting for you.

How to Use

  • Step 1

    Find a Service Counter
    Business hours and fees vary by service counter.
    Please check them before visiting.

    Find a Service Counter for Baggage Delivery Service

  • Step 2

    Visit the service counter.
    Fill out "same-day delivery service form" and make payment at the counter.

  • Step 3

    Send off your baggage and enjoy your day.
    Enjoy sightseeing in comfort without the burden of carrying baggage. (Tourist information services are also available at the counter.)

  • Step 4

    Receive your baggage on the same day*.
    Your baggage will be delivered to the destination on the same day.

    • *Delivery time varies depending on the designated area.

Precautions for use

  • Fees vary depending on the baggage size and service counter.
  • The cut-off time for drop off varies by service counter.
  • Baggage arrival time varies depending on the destination.
  • For delivery to the airport, the Airport Express Delivery Fee will be charged in addition to the regular service fees.
